description: Complete backend API — all Express routes, controllers, services, middleware, and the ML FastAPI service. Depends on FEAT-001 (Prisma schema and seed must exist). Independent of FEAT-003 (frontend). Covers Phases 1-9, 11-14 of the plan: auth, buildings, rooms, timetable, availability, reservations, resources, complaints, AI copilot, analytics, optimization, simulation, energy, reports, ML proxy.
steps: Create campus-x/backend/src/utils/response.ts exporting: sendSuccess(res, data, message?, statusCode=200), sendError(res, message, statusCode=400, errors?). Both return { success: bool, data, message, errors } shape.

Create campus-x/backend/src/utils/period.ts exporting: PERIOD_TIMES array of {period:number, start:string, end:string} for periods 1-8 (e.g. period 1 = 08:00-08:55, period 2 = 09:00-09:55, ... period 8 = 15:00-15:55). Export getCurrentPeriod(date?:Date):number|null (returns null if outside all periods). Export getPeriodTimes(period:number):{start:string,end:string}. Export isDayOfWeek(date:Date):DayOfWeek|null (returns null for Sunday).

Create campus-x/backend/src/utils/jwt.ts exporting: signAccessToken(payload), signRefreshToken(payload), verifyAccessToken(token), verifyRefreshToken(token). Read JWT_SECRET and JWT_REFRESH_SECRET from process.env.

Create campus-x/backend/src/middleware/auth.ts with: authenticateToken (reads Bearer token from Authorization header, verifies, attaches req.user = {id,email,role}), requireRole(roles:Role[]) (403 if req.user.role not in roles). Export both.

Create campus-x/backend/src/middleware/upload.ts using multer: blueprintUpload (dest: uploads/blueprints/, accept image/png,image/jpeg,application/pdf, max 10MB), resourceUpload (dest: uploads/resources/, accept pdf/doc/docx/ppt/pptx/zip/png/jpg, max 50MB), complaintImageUpload (dest: uploads/complaints/, accept image/*, max 5MB). Rename files to uuid + original extension.
Create campus-x/backend/src/middleware/validate.ts: a validate(schema:ZodSchema) middleware that calls schema.safeParse(req.body) and returns 400 with errors if invalid.
Create campus-x/backend/src/services/audit.ts exporting logAction(userId, action, entityType, entityId?, details?, ipAddress?). Inserts AuditLog record via Prisma.

Create campus-x/backend/src/app.ts: initialize Express, apply helmet(), cors({origin: FRONTEND_URL, credentials:true}), morgan('dev'), express.json(), express.urlencoded(), express.static('uploads') at /uploads. Mount all route files under /api prefix. Export app.
Create campus-x/backend/src/server.ts: import app, call app.listen(PORT, callback). Export nothing.

Implement campus-x/backend/src/routes/auth.ts with controllers in campus-x/backend/src/controllers/auth.ts: POST /register (hash password, create User, return tokens), POST /login (verify password, return accessToken+refreshToken, log audit), POST /refresh (verify refreshToken, return new accessToken), POST /logout (client-side — return success), GET /me (authenticateToken, return req.user from DB). Zod schemas for register and login bodies.

Implement campus-x/backend/src/routes/buildings.ts + controllers/buildings.ts: GET / (list all buildings with floor count), POST / (admin, create building, zod validate), GET /:id (single building with floors and rooms), PUT /:id (admin, update), DELETE /:id (admin, soft delete isActive=false), POST /:id/blueprint (admin, blueprintUpload middleware, update Floor.blueprintUrl), GET /:buildingId/floors (list floors), POST /:buildingId/floors (admin, create floor).

Implement campus-x/backend/src/routes/rooms.ts + controllers/rooms.ts: GET / (list with filters: buildingId, floorId, type, status, capacity, department), POST / (admin, create room with zod validation), GET /:id (single room with building+floor), PUT /:id (admin, update), PATCH /:id/status (faculty+admin, update status with reason), GET /available/now (calls availability service for currentPeriod).
Implement campus-x/backend/src/routes/departments.ts: GET / (list), POST / (admin), GET /:id (with subjects and faculty count), PUT /:id (admin).

Implement campus-x/backend/src/routes/timetable.ts + controllers/timetable.ts + services/conflict.ts: GET /entries (filters: classId, semesterId, facultyId, roomId, day), POST /entries (admin, create single entry, run conflict check), PUT /entries/:id (admin, update, re-check conflicts), DELETE /entries/:id (admin), POST /import (admin, CSV upload via multer memoryStorage, parse with csv-parse, batch insert after conflict check on each row), GET /conflicts (admin, returns all current conflicts for active semester), GET /classes (list all classes), POST /classes (admin, create class), GET /semesters (list), POST /semesters (admin, create), GET /subjects (list with dept filter), POST /subjects (admin). Conflict service: detectConflicts(entries[]):ConflictResult[] — checks room double-booked, faculty double-booked, class double-booked, room capacity < class strength.

Implement campus-x/backend/src/services/availability.ts: findAvailableRooms(params: {date:Date, period:number, capacity?:number, type?:RoomType, buildingId?:string, equipment?:string[]}) — query rooms where isActive=true AND status=AVAILABLE AND capacity >= requested AND no TimetableEntry for room+day+period in active semester AND no RoomReservation for room+date+periodRange with status=ACTIVE. Return Room[] sorted by capacity ASC. findCurrentlyAvailableRooms() — use getCurrentPeriod(). isClassFree(classId, period, date) — checks TimetableEntry for class on that day+period.

Implement campus-x/backend/src/routes/availability.ts: GET /rooms (query params: date, period, capacity, type, building_id, equipment — call findAvailableRooms), GET /now (call findCurrentlyAvailableRooms), GET /class (query: class_id, period, date — call isClassFree).

Implement campus-x/backend/src/routes/reservations.ts + controllers/reservations.ts: POST / (faculty+admin, create reservation — check conflict with availability service before insert, return 409 if conflict), GET / (admin: all, faculty: own + their class, student: readonly their class), GET /my (own reservations), DELETE /:id (cancel — only owner or admin), PATCH /:id/status (admin). Auto-mark EXPIRED: on every GET, compute if reservation's date+periodEnd < now and update status=EXPIRED.

Implement campus-x/backend/src/routes/resources.ts + controllers/resources.ts: POST /upload (faculty+admin, resourceUpload middleware, zod validate metadata: title,subjectId,departmentId,semester,academicYear,examType,regulation,description,isPublic), GET / (all roles, filter by subjectCode,departmentId,semester,academicYear,examType, students get only isApproved=true), GET /:id/download (student+faculty+admin, increment downloadCount, return fileUrl), PATCH /:id/approve (admin, set isApproved=true), DELETE /:id (admin or uploader), GET /my (own uploads).

Implement campus-x/backend/src/routes/complaints.ts + controllers/complaints.ts: POST / (all authenticated roles, complaintImageUpload optional, auto-generate autoId like CMP-2026-001 via sequence), GET / (admin: all with filters; faculty: own dept; student: own), GET /:id (with updates timeline), PATCH /:id/assign (admin, assign to user), PATCH /:id/status (admin+assigned, update status, create ComplaintUpdate record), GET /stats (admin: counts by status, category, building).

Implement campus-x/backend/src/services/ai-copilot.ts: classifyIntent(query:string):Intent — keyword matching for LOCATION_SEARCH (keywords: where is, find, locate, room, lab, cabin, restroom), AVAILABILITY_SEARCH (available, free, empty, vacant), RESOURCE_SEARCH (question paper, notes, subject, download), COMPLAINT_QUERY (complaint, issue, problem, status), TIMETABLE_QUERY (timetable, schedule, class, period), GENERAL_INFO (fallback). Then queryDB(intent, query, userRole) — extract entities from query string, run appropriate Prisma queries, return structured result. If OPENAI_API_KEY env present, use axios to call GPT-4o-mini for better extraction. NEVER return data not in DB. If no result, return {found:false, message:'I couldn\'t find that in the campus database'}.
Implement campus-x/backend/src/routes/ai.ts: POST /query (authenticateToken, call classifyIntent+queryDB, return {intent, response, data[]}).

Implement campus-x/backend/src/services/analytics.ts + routes/analytics.ts: GET /overview (counts: buildings, rooms, availableNow, occupied, maintenance, activeComplaints, pendingComplaints, resolvedToday, todayClasses, utilizationPercent = occupied/(occupied+available)*100), GET /utilization (room utilization by building for last 7 days — count TimetableEntries per room per day / total periods), GET /complaints (complaint counts by week for last 8 weeks, grouped by status), GET /alerts (rooms over capacity in timetable, conflicts in active semester, complaints open >7 days, rooms with >3 open complaints, energy anomalies in last 24h). All routes require admin role.

Implement campus-x/backend/src/routes/optimization.ts: GET /suggest?semester_id= (admin, analyze TimetableEntries in semester: find rooms where capacity > class_strength * 2 = oversized, rooms of wrong department, equipment mismatches — return array of {entryId, currentRoom, suggestedRoom, reason, efficiencyGain}), POST /apply (admin, array of {entryId, newRoomId}, update TimetableEntries, log audit, return updated count).

Implement campus-x/backend/src/routes/simulation.ts: POST /run (admin+faculty, body: {scenario_type: ROOM_UNAVAILABLE|CLASS_ADDED|STRENGTH_INCREASE, params:{}}). ROOM_UNAVAILABLE: mark room unavailable in simulation, find affected TimetableEntries, suggest alternatives. CLASS_ADDED: simulate adding a class to a period, detect conflicts. STRENGTH_INCREASE: simulate class strength increase, find rooms that become too small. READ-ONLY — never write to DB. Return {conflicts[], affected_classes[], affected_rooms[], suggestions[]}.

Implement campus-x/backend/src/routes/energy.ts + controllers/energy.ts: POST /records (admin, bulk insert EnergyRecord, auto-detect anomaly: if consumption > mean+2*stddev for that building+hour across all days), GET /data (filter: buildingId, startDate, endDate, groupBy: hour/day/week), GET /anomalies (filter: buildingId, date range), GET /summary (total kWh per building for period, comparison to previous period).

Implement campus-x/backend/src/routes/reports.ts: GET /:type where type = room-utilization|complaints|timetable|energy|resources. Accept ?format=csv. For CSV: use manual CSV string construction (no extra dep). Return Content-Disposition: attachment header. All report routes require admin role.

Implement campus-x/ml-service/main.py fully: FastAPI app with: (1) Generate synthetic training data on startup (100 rows per model with datetime features). (2) Train RandomForestRegressor/Classifier for demand (predict room demand for next 7 days based on day_of_week, period, room_type, building features), energy (predict kWh for next 24h based on hour, day_of_week, building_id, historical mean), maintenance (predict maintenance need probability based on complaint_count_30d, age_years, room_type). (3) POST /ml/predict/demand body {room_id?, building_id?, days_ahead:int}, POST /ml/predict/energy body {building_id, hours_ahead:int}, POST /ml/predict/maintenance body {room_id}. All responses include disclaimer field: 'Based on synthetic demonstration data'. (4) GET /health.

Implement campus-x/backend/src/routes/ml.ts: proxy routes GET /demand-forecast, /energy-forecast, /maintenance-forecast that call ML service via axios at ML_SERVICE_URL env. Return ML service response to client. All routes require admin role.

Mount all routes in app.ts under /api: /api/auth, /api/buildings, /api/rooms, /api/departments, /api/timetable, /api/availability, /api/reservations, /api/resources, /api/complaints, /api/ai, /api/analytics, /api/optimization, /api/simulation, /api/energy, /api/reports, /api/ml. Add 404 handler and global error handler (log error, return 500 with sendError).
Run `cd campus-x/backend && npm run build` to confirm TypeScript compiles with zero errors.
acceptance_criteria: `cd campus-x/backend && npm run build` exits 0 with no TypeScript errors
`cd campus-x/backend && npm run dev` starts on port 3001 without runtime errors
POST /api/auth/login with {email:admin@campusx.edu, password:Admin@123} returns 200 with accessToken
GET /api/buildings with Authorization Bearer token returns 200 with 5 buildings
GET /api/availability/rooms?period=3&capacity=45 returns rooms with capacity>=45 not occupied in period 3
POST /api/ai/query {query:'Where is the ladies restroom near CSE block?'} returns location data from DB (demo scenario 5)
POST /api/complaints with valid body creates complaint with auto-generated CMP-YYYY-NNN id (demo scenario 6)
GET /api/analytics/overview returns object with buildings, rooms, activeComplaints fields (demo scenario 7)
GET /api/analytics/alerts returns array (may be empty) (demo scenario 7)
`cd campus-x/ml-service && uvicorn main:app --port 8001` starts and POST /ml/predict/demand returns prediction with disclaimer field
